purpose: Runtime package cleanup, JSON ownership clarification and safe redundancy removal
changes: Consolidated style.css into styles.css and removed the redundant stylesheet file.
Moved Model Audit and Data Enrichment tools into public/developer/.
Moved generated validation/audit JSON into public/developer/data/.
Updated all affected HTML, CSS, JavaScript and fetch paths.
Removed the unnamed blank field from 282 boat model records.
Removed four byte-identical generated-report copies; developer/data is now the single report location.
Retired missions.json because it duplicated routes.json with inconsistent data types and one empty record.
Removed the unused missions dataset load and mission count from application startup.
Added data/data-manifest.json to distinguish managed data, generated indexes, developer reports and retired files.
Merged legacy production-year ownership into FirstYear and LastYear and retired YearStart/YearEnd.
Retired Length_ft; retained HullLength_ft only where it differs materially from LOA_ft.
Moved aliases, legacy IDs, identity resolution notes and audit disposition to boat-registry.json.
Removed BoatSubFamily because it exactly duplicated Configuration.
Replaced uncontrolled Confidence with controlled DataConfidence.
Normalized ResearchStatus to five workflow values.
Removed FeatureDataStatus because completeness is calculated from actual fields.
phase2SafeSchemaNormalization.compatibility: Filtering fields and unknown-data behavior are unchanged. Unknown confidence remains explicit and never eliminates a candidate.

changes: Replaced manually maintained knowledge cards with generated cards for all models
Removed repeated manufacturer/model/displayName identity blocks from intelligence, resources and listing sources
Added knowledgeannotations.json for unique card-only editorial content
Added deterministic developer/generate-knowledge-cards.js build step
Established one authoritative source for specifications, intelligence, resources, listings and annotations
Retired data/registry/legacy-id-map.json from runtime.
Preserved legacy identifiers as registry aliases.
Moved registry migration and audit metadata to developer/archive/identity-migration-archive.json.
Integrated manufacturerknowledge.json through a runtime repository.
Added one deterministic developer report generator for registry, identity, taxonomy and knowledge reports.
phase4.policy: Unknown model or manufacturer knowledge remains unknown and cannot cause exclusion.
